BiblicalUsage: This word names the flute, and it appears only in the title of the fifth psalm, where the psalm is given to the chief musician upon Nehiloth. The word itself never stands in a verse of the psalm; it lives only in the heading that tells how the psalm was to be sung.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe even the heading matters: God gave His psalms to be sung with instruments, and the flute that leads the fifth psalm is part of how His people worshipped.
